# fmv-egui-commonmark-backend

FastMarkdownViewer's maintained fork of [egui_commonmark_backend 0.25.0](https://github.com/lampsitter/egui_commonmark), originally by Erlend Walstad. This is not an official upstream release. The library crate name remains `egui_commonmark_backend` for source compatibility.

See [FASTMARKDOWNVIEWER-PATCHES.md](FASTMARKDOWNVIEWER-PATCHES.md) for the rendering, layout and interaction fixes carried by this fork. Original MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses are included. The viewer uses runtime Markdown parsing; the viewer fork does not ship the upstream compile-time Markdown macros.
